camel_example: aliyun eci ExecContainerCommand --region cn-hangzhou --ContainerName nginx --Command '/bin/sh_,_-c_,_ls_-a' --TTY false --ContainerGroupId 'eci-2zebxkiifulhl0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Sync false --Stdin true
description_en: Executes a command in a container
description_zh: 调用ExecContainerCommand在容器内部执行命令
kebab_example: aliyun eci exec-container-command --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --container-group-id eci-2zebxkiifulhl0000 --container-name nginx --command /bin/sh_,_-c_,_ls_-a --tty false --stdin true --sync false --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExecContainerCommand

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID, which is the container group ID
parameters.name: container_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The commands to execute in the container. You can specify up to 20 commands. Each command can be up to 256 characters long.
To execute multiple commands, pass the string in JSON format. For example, `["/bin/sh", "-c", "ls -a"]`.
parameters.help_zh:
要在容器内执行的命令序列。最多20个命令，单个命令最长256个字符。    
执行多个命令时，字符串需按照JSON格式传入，例如：`["/bin/sh", "-c", "ls -a"]`
parameters.name: command

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable interaction. The default value is false.
If you set Command to `/bin/bash`, set this parameter to true.
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启交互。默认为false。    
当Command为`/bin/bash`命令时，需要设置为true
parameters.name: tty

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable standard input. The default value is true
parameters.name: stdin

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to execute the command immediately and return the result synchronously. The default value is false.
If you set this parameter to true, you must set TTY to false. This means Command cannot be `/bin/bash`.
parameters.help_zh:
是否立即执行命令并同步返回结果。默认为false。    
如果设置为true，TTY只能设置为false（即Command不是`/bin/bash`命令）
parameters.name: sync
